commands.name: init
commands.does: ask questions, write the profile, render templates, vendor the CLI

commands.name: upgrade
commands.does: re-vendor the CLI from the installed plugin

commands.name: index
commands.does: regenerate every index.md in the bundle

commands.name: check
commands.does: OKF validation, plan lint, profile lint

commands.name: status
commands.does: print the state table

commands.name: next
commands.does: print the single next action

commands.name: lane
commands.does: print the computed lane and why

commands.name: card
commands.does: render the unit card

commands.name: start
commands.does: name the worktree branch unit/U-<n> and check its base

commands.name: reserve
commands.does: next free number for a reservation

commands.name: approve
commands.does: stamp approval (owner only)

commands.name: review
commands.does: store a reviewer verdict keyed by diff hash

commands.name: report
commands.does: store the builder's report (JSON on stdin)

commands.name: hold
commands.does: record an owner hold in the plan

commands.name: priority
commands.does: record an owner priority in the plan

commands.name: fix
commands.does: create a one-unit plan without an intent

commands.name: sync
commands.does: project intents and units onto GitHub issues and a Project

commands.name: push
commands.does: push the base after checking its new commits

commands.name: clean
commands.does: remove orphan worktrees and branches

commands.name: merge
commands.does: run the merge gate, then merge --no-ff with trailers

commands.name: hook
commands.does: entry point for hooks; reads the hook JSON on stdin

messages.unionNotList: {{layer}}: {{key}} must be a list; a {{union}} from an earlier layer cannot be removed
messages.unionReplaced: {{layer}}: {{key}} replaces an object holding a {{union}} from an earlier layer
messages.strayEnd: {{file}}: end of each block without a start
messages.indexFrontmatter: index.md may carry frontmatter only at the bundle root, with only {{keys}}
messages.indexLine: list line is not a * [Title](url) - description entry
messages.logFrontmatter: log.md frontmatter is not a valid YAML mapping
messages.indexStale: index differs from what aidlc index generates
messages.ruleFixed: docs.rules.{{code}}: spec codes cannot be changed
messages.ruleLevel: docs.rules.{{code}}: level must be error, warning or off
messages.yamlKey: line {{line}}: expected a key: value pair
messages.yamlColon: line {{line}}: mapping values are not allowed here
messages.yamlTrailing: line {{line}}: unexpected text after a value
messages.depUnknown: {{unit}} depends on {{dep}}, which does not exist
messages.reserveKind: reservation kind {{kind}} is not in profile.reserve
messages.scopeOverlap: {{unit}} scope {{glob}} overlaps {{other}} scope {{otherGlob}} with no depends path between them
messages.laneStandard: {{item}} is outside lanes.quick and overlaps no full or focus glob
messages.noEmail: git config user.email is not set
messages.notApprovable: {{name}} is not an intent, unit or decision doc
messages.nextContinueMerge: finish the merge of {{unit}}: aidlc merge {{unit}}, or git merge --abort
messages.nextReapprove: re-approve {{docs}} after their edits: ! node .aidlc/bin/aidlc.mjs approve {{docs}}
messages.nextNoIntent: elaborate an intent with the owner in {{dir}}/I-1-<slug>.md, then ask for approval
messages.nextApproveIntent: ask the owner to approve {{intent}}: ! node .aidlc/bin/aidlc.mjs approve {{intent}}
messages.nextDraftUnits: draft the units of {{intent}} in {{dir}}/U-<n>-<slug>.md, then ask for the plan approval
messages.nextApprovePlan: ask the owner to approve the plan: ! node .aidlc/bin/aidlc.mjs approve {{units}}
messages.nextFixRound: fix round for {{unit}}: builder (card: aidlc card {{unit}})
messages.nextReview: review {{unit}}, focus {{focus}}: reviewer on {{model}} (card: aidlc card {{unit}})
messages.nextRestart: restart the builder of {{unit}} from branch {{branch}} (card: aidlc card {{unit}})
messages.nextHeld: {{units}} on hold: the owner releases them
messages.nextRelease: {{intent}} is merged: release with the owner
messages.nextIdle: all intents released: elaborate the next intent with the owner
messages.cardRefused: {{unit}} is {{state}}: the owner approves it before a card is rendered
messages.cardTooLong: card for {{unit}} is {{size}} chars, over {{max}}: shorten the unit doc
messages.modelFix: fix round after a CONFIRMED finding
messages.notWorktree: start runs in a builder's worktree, not the main checkout
messages.noCard: no card for {{unit}}: the lead runs aidlc card {{unit}} first
messages.baseMismatch: worktree is at {{head}}, the card of {{unit}} at {{base}}: restart the builder from a fresh card
messages.branchTaken: {{branch}} is checked out in {{path}}, with uncommitted work or a live builder: stop and report
messages.nextApproveRequirements: ask the owner to approve the requirements the plan cites: ! node .aidlc/bin/aidlc.mjs approve {{reqs}}
messages.initKept: kept {{path}}: it exists; rerun with --overwrite {{path}} to replace it
messages.initSettingKept: kept {{key}} in {{path}}: it is set to {{value}}
messages.initAdopted: adopted the bundle at {{bundle}} as of {{commit}}
messages.initNoBundle: no bundle with okf_version found: run init without --adopt
messages.initFindings: bundle: {{errors}} spec errors, {{warnings}} house-rule warnings (aidlc check {{bundle}} lists them)
messages.initLeftoverDir: leftover: {{path}}/ is not a known folder; left untouched
messages.initLeftoverTrailer: leftover: commit trailer {{key}} in {{count}} commits; history is left as is
messages.initNotPlugin: init and upgrade run from the installed plugin, not from {{path}}
messages.initNeedsRepo: init runs in a git repository
messages.gateNotBase: merge runs in the checkout of {{base}}
messages.gateDeps: {{unit}} depends on {{dep}}, which is not merged
messages.gateShared: {{path}} is written by merge, not by a builder
messages.gateLane: the diff is {{lane}} lane ({{reason}}), the card {{card}}
messages.gateLevel: {{tag}} is tested in {{files}}, outside the {{level}} paths
messages.gateProof: {{level}} tests pass with the production change reverted
messages.gateNoRun: level {{level}} has no run command for proof-revert
messages.gateReview: no pass verdict for the current diff of {{unit}}
messages.gateCardStale: the review was made against card {{reviewed}}, the current card is {{card}}
messages.gateSpecialist: {{focus}} review required ({{why}}), no pass verdict for the current diff
messages.ciScope: merge {{sha}} of {{unit}} changes {{path}}, outside its scope
messages.fixWrote: wrote {{path}}, {{lane}} lane{{#each approve}}; the owner approves it: ! node .aidlc/bin/aidlc.mjs approve {{this}}{{/each}}
messages.fixFull: {{title}} is full lane ({{reason}}): it needs an intent, like any feature
messages.hookEscalate: escalate: {{reason}} (denied {{count}} times this turn; stop and tell the owner)
messages.scopeApproval: {{path}}: approvals and verified_hash are the owner's
messages.secretFound: {{path}} contains what looks like a secret
messages.statusResume: Load the aidlc skill and run aidlc next.
messages.boardOff: no github section in the profile: the board is off
messages.boardProject: github.project {{project}} is not orgs/<owner>/projects/<n> or users/<owner>/projects/<n>
messages.boardFailed: warning: sync failed, run aidlc sync: {{error}}
messages.nextMigrate: elaborate the migration intent with the owner in {{dir}}/I-1-<slug>.md (adopted at {{commit}}): docs, always-on context, profile, architecture baseline, module audit, cleanup; then ask for approval

OKF-FM.fix: give the file a terminated --- block of YAML key: value pairs

OKF-TYPE.fix: add a non-empty type: to the frontmatter

HOUSE-DESC.fix: add title: and a one-sentence description:

HOUSE-LINK.fix: point the link at an existing file or remove it

HOUSE-SIZE.fix: split the doc or move detail into linked docs

PROFILE-RULE.fix: set docs.rules entries to a HOUSE-* code and one of error, warning, off

PLAN-DAG.fix: remove the cycle or point depends at an existing unit

PLAN-AC.fix: give each AC in the unit its own AC-<k>

PLAN-LEVEL.fix: write - AC-<k> (<level>): with a level from profile.levels

PLAN-RESERVE.fix: use <kind> <area>/<n> with a kind from profile.reserve and a number no other unit holds

PLAN-SCOPE.fix: give the unit a scope, narrow the scopes, or add a depends between the units

PLAN-REQ.fix: cite the requirements the intent or unit serves: requirements: [R-<n>]

GATE-APPROVAL.fix: the owner approves the unit: ! node .aidlc/bin/aidlc.mjs approve <unit>

SCOPE-OUT.fix: move the change into scope, or the lead widens the scope and the owner re-approves

GATE-LANE.fix: the lead raises the unit's lane, re-renders the card and restarts the review

GATE-AC.fix: add a test tagged with the AC

GATE-LEVEL.fix: move the test under the level's paths in profile.levels

GATE-PROOF.fix: make the AC test fail without the production change

GATE-CHECK.fix: fix the module until its check passes

GATE-REVIEW.fix: run the reviewer on the current diff and card: aidlc review record

GATE-CARD.fix: render the card (aidlc card) and review against it

GATE-SPECIALIST.fix: run the reviewer with that focus on the current diff

GATE-OKF.fix: fix the doc, then run aidlc check

GATE-SECURITY.fix: fix what the security check reports

ARCH-BOUNDARY.fix: remove the dependency, or the owner approves an exception decision

ARCH-CHECK.fix: fix what the architecture check reports

GATE-SHARED.fix: revert the change; merge writes indexes, logs and shared files

GATE-CONFLICT.fix: merge the base into the unit branch, resolve, and report again

CI-MERGE.fix: merge units only with aidlc merge

CI-COMMIT.fix: commit code only through units; direct commits may touch only docs and workflow files

PUSH-COMMIT.fix: move the change into a unit; direct commits may touch only docs and workflow files

GUARD-FORCE.fix: push without force; history on shared branches is never rewritten

GUARD-PUSH.fix: push the base with aidlc push

GUARD-BASE-DELETE.fix: the base branch is never deleted

GUARD-NOVERIFY.fix: commit with hooks; fix what they report

GUARD-BASE-COMMIT.fix: commit code only in a unit worktree; on the base commit only docs

GUARD-APPROVE.fix: only the owner approves, with ! node .aidlc/bin/aidlc.mjs approve

GUARD-RELEASE.fix: the owner confirms tags and releases

SCOPE-OUT.fix: stop and report; the lead widens the scope

SCOPE-SHARED.fix: leave indexes, logs and shared files to aidlc merge

SCOPE-APPROVAL.fix: only the owner approves, with ! node .aidlc/bin/aidlc.mjs approve

SECRET.fix: keep secrets out of the repo; read them from the environment

MODEL-UNIT.fix: name the unit U-<n> in the prompt and start it from its card

MODEL-MISMATCH.fix: pass the model the card names (aidlc card)

queries.project: query($login: String!, $number: Int!, $cursor: String) { {{owner}}(login: $login) { projectV2(number: $number) { id fields(first: 50) { nodes { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { id name dataType } ... on ProjectV2SingleSelectField { options { id name } } } } items(first: 100, after: $cursor) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id content { ... on Issue { number repository { nameWithOwner } } } fieldValues(first: 30) { nodes { ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldSingleSelectValue { name field { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { name } } } ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldNumberValue { number field { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { name } } } ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldDateValue { date field { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { name } } } ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldTextValue { text field { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { name } } } } } } } } } }
queries.addItem: mutation($project: ID!, $content: ID!) { addProjectV2ItemById(input: { projectId: $project, contentId: $content }) { item { id } } }
queries.setField: mutation($project: ID!, $item: ID!, $field: ID!, $value: ProjectV2FieldValue!) { updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue(input: { projectId: $project, itemId: $item, fieldId: $field, value: $value }) { projectV2Item { id } } }
